Overall the PR is solid: comparing by `activePlanId` (not `activePlanName`) is the right fix for PLA-2003, the elevation-gated checkout is properly pinned in `elevation.integration.spec.ts`, and the seat‑capacity path is well tested. A few things to consider improving:

---

#### 1. `previewSubscriptionUpdate` skips the seat‑capacity check — inconsistent with its doc

`billing.service.ts:190-223`. The doc says:

> Rejects for the same reasons as the PATCH, bar one: it does not require an updatable subscription.

But `updateSubscription` calls `assertSafeSeatCapacity`, and `previewSubscriptionUpdate` does not. So a downgrade preview succeeds and returns a price, then the follow‑up PATCH 409s. The client sees a quotable number but can never commit it. Either add the same check (probably the right choice — it lets the UI disable/annotate the CTA before the user clicks), or update the doc to state seat capacity is intentionally NOT checked on preview and explain why.

[Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=In%20src%2Fmodules%2Fbilling%2Froutes%2Fbilling.service.ts%2C%20add%20an%20assertSafeSeatCapacity%20call%20to%20previewSubscriptionUpdate%20so%20a%20downgrade%20whose%20target%20plan%20cannot%20fit%20the%20workspace%27s%20current%20Safes%20is%20rejected%20at%20preview%20time%20too%20-%20matching%20the%20behavior%20its%20docstring%20claims.%20Add%20a%20matching%20spec%20under%20describe%28%27previewSubscriptionUpdate%27%29.%20Branch%3A%20moisesf%2Fpla-2003-cgw-payment-link-offer-filter-excludes-sibling-plans-sharing&repo=safe-global/safe-client-gateway)

---

#### 2. `assertSafeSeatCapacity` parses the quota twice

`billing.service.ts:428-447`. `parseSafeSeatQuota(...)` runs in the guard clause, then `hasSeatCapacity(link, used)` inside its body parses the same metadata again. Not a bug — just wasted work and slightly awkward. Cleaner:

```ts
const quota = parseSafeSeatQuota(
  args.paymentLink.metadata,
  (m) => this.loggingService.warn(m),
);
if (quota === null) return;
const used = await this.spaceSafesRepository.countBySpaceId(args.spaceId);
if (used > quota) {
  throw new ConflictException(
    "This plan doesn't offer enough Safe seats for the workspace's current Safes",
  );
}
```

`hasSeatCapacity` currently has exactly one caller (this method); if you go this route it can be removed from `payment-link-offer.rules.ts` and its unit tests folded away, keeping the rule module focused on offer selection.

[Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=In%20src%2Fmodules%2Fbilling%2Froutes%2Fbilling.service.ts%2C%20refactor%20assertSafeSeatCapacity%20to%20call%20parseSafeSeatQuota%20exactly%20once%20-%20store%20the%20result%2C%20guard%20on%20null%2C%20then%20compare%20used%20%3E%20quota%20directly%20-%20and%20remove%20hasSeatCapacity%20from%20src%2Fmodules%2Fbilling%2Fdomain%2Fpayment-link-offer.rules.ts%20and%20its%20tests%20in%20payment-link-offer.rules.spec.ts%20since%20it%20would%20be%20unused.%20Branch%3A%20moisesf%2Fpla-2003-cgw-payment-link-offer-filter-excludes-sibling-plans-sharing&repo=safe-global/safe-client-gateway)

---

#### 3. Nit: `ApiConflictResponse` on `PATCH .../subscriptions/:subscriptionId` merges four unrelated 409 causes into one prose sentence

`billing.controller.ts:274-277`. Fine as documentation, but it forces the client to string‑match the message to distinguish them. If you already return distinct message strings server‑side, consider a short bullet list in the description or dedicated error codes to make the outcomes machine‑distinguishable.

---

#### 4. Nit: consider narrowing the OpenAPI 403 wording on `updateSubscription`

`billing.controller.ts:270-272` says `"Not an admin, or a plan this workspace is not offered"` but the service also throws 403 for a `paymentLinkId` that is not in the offered set (`paymentLinkForPlanOrFail` → `ForbiddenException`). Small clarity gain to mention that third case.

---

Nothing above blocks merging. The correctness fix and the security tightening (admin + elevation) are good.
 — branch `moisesf/pla-2003-cgw-payment-link-offer-filter-excludes-sibling-plans-sharing`
